description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between  A . Hewagama with 45 others and Southern Provincial Road Development Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the revocation and issuance of orders under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments, and contains formal legal orders regarding industrial dispute arbitration procedures. While it mentions a government minister (Ravindra Samaraweera), it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation, without detailing portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
